action: PART 5 REMAINS HALTED. Historical diagnostic downgraded, not repaired.

1_accounting_was_wrong_in_BOTH_direction.how_I_got_it_wrong: I listed 4 noncommensurable base features and 3 affected products, then asserted 14 minus 2 = 12 by treating everything outside my 2-item commensurable list as affected. That silently swept in log_distance^2, degree^2 and log_distance*degree, which are deterministic functions of commensurable bases and are therefore themselves commensurable. Simultaneously I left the two depth-sensitivity features unclassified, when they belong firmly in the affected set. The number 12 did not follow from my own list.
1_accounting_was_wrong_in_BOTH_direction.lesson: I asserted a summary count instead of counting the list I had just written.

2_depth_sensitivities_are_ALSO_mismatche.synthetic_definition: in the frozen estimator, rna_sens = mean over metacells of (z-scored signal) x (z-scored depth). Both factors are standardised, so this is a dimensionless CORRELATION-LIKE quantity bounded in [-1, 1]. The committed synthetic range [-0.322, 0.716] is consistent with that.
2_depth_sensitivities_are_ALSO_mismatche.real_definition_in_the_frozen_contract: 'within-donor slope of the gene's metacell RNA value on metacell total RNA counts' -- a REGRESSION SLOPE, carrying units of RNA per count and unbounded.
2_depth_sensitivities_are_ALSO_mismatche.verdict: A correlation and a regression slope are not the same quantity. These two columns are noncommensurable and I had marked them only 'partially' comparable.
2_depth_sensitivities_are_ALSO_mismatche.consequence: the 14-D Mahalanobis comparison is invalid regardless of re_density

3_the_19.1_SD_figure_was_mislabelled.what_I_wrote: the real median sits 19.1 synthetic standard deviations from the synthetic mean
3_the_19.1_SD_figure_was_mislabelled.why_that_framing_is_wrong: a standard-deviation distance presumes a shared metric. When the two variables are different quantities there is no transport meaning to the number; it is not a distance, it is an artifact of dividing one thing by the spread of a different thing.
3_the_19.1_SD_figure_was_mislabelled.correct_reading: the re_density numbers are EVIDENCE OF UNIT MISMATCH, not a measure of how far NIH-CARD lies from the simulator.

commensurable_5_of_14.log_distance: log base pairs on both sides
commensurable_5_of_14.promoter_degree: an integer count on both sides
commensurable_5_of_14.log_distance_squared: deterministic function of a commensurable base
commensurable_5_of_14.degree_squared: deterministic function of a commensurable base

INFERENTIAL_INDEPENDENCE_CAVEAT.rule: The three polynomial transforms are deterministic functions of log_distance and promoter_degree. They may be REPORTED but must NOT be counted as additional independent support.

log_distance.verdict: NIH-CARD lies ENTIRELY INSIDE the historical support

promoter_degree.detail: 14.76% at degree 1, below the synthetic minimum of 2; 9.53% above the synthetic maximum of 11

the_other_nine_columns.permitted: separate standardisation of each side for SHAPE and RANK comparison, reported descriptively
the_other_nine_columns.forbidden: treating that as a support-overlap claim. Standardising two different quantities separately does not make them semantically equivalent and cannot rescue the original claim.

IMPLICATION_FOR_THE_REALISM_LANE.statement: The historical simulator remains valuable for its NUISANCE LOGIC -- the families, the semantic twin, the held-out ambient arm, the out-of-basis nonlinear arm -- and that logic is unchanged and still used.
IMPLICATION_FOR_THE_REALISM_LANE.but: it is NOT a valid metric-space reference for NIH-CARD, so it cannot serve as the yardstick for whether real geometry is in or out of span.
IMPLICATION_FOR_THE_REALISM_LANE.consequence: the realism-calibrated simulator, which is in real units by construction, is the correct instrument for that question. This finding raises its importance rather than lowering it.

S45_depth_sensitivity_realism.note: now doubly implicated: it is both a realism gap AND one of the noncommensurable columns above
S45_depth_sensitivity_realism.why_not_fixable_in_the_qualification_sta: these values are produced inside frozen T.simulate from simulated donor matrices; they are not world inputs
S45_depth_sensitivity_realism.required: a prospectively frozen SUCCESSOR TO THE SIMULATOR

S46_support_geometry_realism.why_not_fixable_in_the_qualification_sta: every synthetic donor still receives the frozen N_METACELL with complete support, inside frozen T.simulate
S46_support_geometry_realism.required: a prospectively frozen SUCCESSOR TO THE SIMULATOR

REMAINING_OPEN_LIMITATIONS_NOT_TO_BE_ABS.rule: Neither may be silently absorbed into a claim that a world is 'NIH-CARD-like'. Any such claim must name both as excluded.
